info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Retrieval API allows users to access specific deposit lending information based on the provided parameter. It is designed for financial institutions and developers involved in banking services who require detailed insights into merchandising loans. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their operations and improve decision-making related to deposit lending. This endpoint is especially useful for applications that seek to present tailored lending options to their customers.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific merchandising loan.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific merchandising loan identified by its loan number. It includes relevant financial details and status updates, providing a comprehensive overview for stakeholders.
